newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya shilling eases marginally vs dlr.
newsitem.headline: Kenya shilling eases marginally vs dlr.

text.p: The Kenyan shilling opened Monday marginally weaker against the dollar but firmed on the pound, commercial bank dealers said.
The Central Bank of Kenya posted a shilling mean rate of 54.46 against the dollar compared to 54.42 on Friday. Against the pound, the shilling was posted at a mean of 90.62 from 90.73.

Dealers said the shilling however was holding steady at 54.40/60 to the dollar in a well matched market. The money market remained tight with overnight rates quoted at 18 percent from Friday's 20 percent.
